name: R12.1 Pull the weekly figures into one dated table

nodes.name: Step 1: Thursday 19:30
nodes.notes: Thursday 7:30 p.m. in the workflow's time zone, after the save window; recheck it after each daylight-saving change.

assignments.name: approved_rules_url
assignments.value: https://<your approved rule versions list API>

assignments.name: sources
assignments.value: [{"id": "<source>", "name": "<source name>", "export_path": "<path to its export>", "control_path": "<path to its control total>", "columns": ["<saved column list>"], "control_column": "<column the control total sums, or empty for the row count>", "manual": false, "data_owner": "<its data owner>"}]

assignments.name: measures
assignments.value: [{"id": "<measure-id>", "name": "<measure>", "source": "<source>", "kind": "<period or status>", "people": false, "formula": {"op": "<count or sum>", "column": "<column summed>", "where": {"<column>": "<value>"}}, "rule_version": "<approved rule version>"}]

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Edit these values for your company; nothing else in the workflow hard-codes them.

nodes.name: Step 1: List the sources
nodes.notes: One item per source; the cut-off is Config's weekday and time, a dated setting changed only through change control.

nodes.name: Read source export
nodes.notes: Retried three times; a file that still cannot be read makes its source stale.

nodes.name: Read control total
nodes.notes: No control total: the source's figures are manual.

parameters.query: WITH reserved AS (INSERT INTO key_log (recipe, key, status) VALUES ($1, $2, 'in progress') ON CONFLICT (recipe, key) DO NOTHING RETURNING key), skipped AS (UPDATE key_log SET copies_skipped = copies_skipped + 1 WHERE recipe = $1 AND key = $2 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reserved)) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM reserved) = 1 AS is_new, $2::text AS key

nodes.name: Step 2: Reserve key
nodes.notes: Key log: refuses a second copy in the same step (book Chapter 2).

nodes.name: Duplicate: stop
nodes.notes: Every file and control total matches a version already made.

nodes.name: Read the weekly table
nodes.notes: Earlier versions: last week's figures and each measure's last good date.

nodes.name: Rules: steps 3 to 8
nodes.notes: Rules decide; there is no AI step in R12.1.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ to: [$('Config').first().json.report_builder, $('Config').first().json.rule_approver], subject: 'Weekly figures stopped: rule version not approved', text: $json.detail }) }}

nodes.name: Step 6: Alert the builder and rule approver

parameters.query: INSERT INTO exception_queue (recipe, item, reason, detail, owner) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) RETURNING id

options.queryReplacement: ={{ ["R12.1", $('Step 2: Fingerprint the files').first().json.week, "rule version not approved", $('Rules: steps 3 to 8').first().json.detail, $('Config').first().json.report_builder] }}

nodes.name: Exception queue: rule version not approved
nodes.notes: Exception queue: a named person works through it (book Chapters 2 and 16).

parameters.query: DELETE FROM key_log WHERE recipe = $1 AND key = $2 RETURNING key

nodes.name: Release key
nodes.notes: No version was written, so the same files run again once the rule is approved or restored.

nodes.name: Step 9: Write to the weekly table
nodes.notes: A write: never retried; a failure is logged and the builder checks the table before any rerun.

parameters.jsCode:
// Only a complete table is marked written; a failed write went to the exception queue instead.
return $input.all().length === $('Step 9: Rows and snapshots').all().length ? [{ json: { complete: true } }] : [];

nodes.name: Step 10: Alert the builder and data owner

parameters.query: INSERT INTO exception_queue (recipe, item, reason, detail, owner) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5) RETURNING id

options.queryReplacement: ={{ ["R12.1", $('Rules: steps 3 to 8').first().json.week + ':' + $('Step 10: Each failed source').item.json.source, "source failed", $('Step 10: Each failed source').item.json.status + ': ' + $('Step 10: Each failed source').item.json.reason, $('Config').first().json.report_builder] }}

nodes.name: Exception queue: source failed
nodes.notes: Exception queue: a named person works through it (book Chapters 2 and 16).

nodes.name: Step 11: Mark the version written
nodes.notes: The latest written version is current: it starts R12.3 and feeds R12.2.

parameters.query: UPDATE key_log SET status = $3, result = $4 WHERE recipe = $1 AND key = $2 RETURNING key
INSERT INTO decision_log (recipe, item, decision, rules) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb) RETURNING id

options.queryReplacement: ={{ ["R12.1", $('Rules: steps 3 to 8').first().json.version, 'written', JSON.stringify({ files: $('Rules: steps 3 to 8').first().json.log, figures: $('Rules: steps 3 to 8').first().json.rows.map(x => ({ measure: x.measure, value: x.value, change: x.change, status: x.status, rule_version: x.rule_version })) })] }}

nodes.name: Decision log
nodes.notes: Decision log: the item's ID, the decision and the rules; never the content (book Chapter 3).
